na174d5c9e8.headline: Listed company: HPS establishes itself in South Africa and wins a major contract
na174d5c9e8.summary: HPS, a Moroccan electronic payment solutions company listed on Casablanca Stock Exchange, opened an office in Johannesburg targeting Southern Africa and secured a major contract.
na174d5c9e8.why: Expansion into Southern Africa by a leading fintech firm reflects growth in regional digital payment ecosystems and cross-border business development.
